message.content: The first recorded instance of Li Hua and Wolfgang having dinner together this year is on January 23rd, 2026. According to the conversation, Wolfgang invited Li Hua to grab dinner together as he was about to be promoted. Wolfgang suggested they meet at a place for dinner before heading to the 8 PM show. Li Hua responded positively, indicating that they planned to meet at a place Wolfgang loved for its carbonara, and agreed to meet at 6:30 PM. This suggests that their first dinner of the year took place at Wolfgang's favorite pasta joint, which they met up at to enjoy a meal before their planned evening entertainment.
